Michelle Bane

title: North Liberty Flock and Axon Agreements

communications.communication:
To the custodian of records:

Pursuant to Iowa Code Chapter 22, I request the following records of the City of North Liberty and the North Liberty Police Department.

1. All executed agreements with Flock Group, Inc. (dba “Flock Safety”), including contracts, memoranda of understanding, order forms, master services agreements, CJIS security addenda, deployment plans, and any attachments or documents incorporated by reference. This includes, without limitation:
  a. The purchase agreement and deployment plan signed in or about June 2024 by the department’s Patrol Lieutenant, as referenced in the police department’s June 2024 monthly report (July 9, 2024 council packet).
  b. Any “free trial,” pilot, or evaluation agreement (typically a memorandum of understanding) in effect before the service agreement.
  c. Any renewal, amendment, order form, or change order executed since the original agreement, including any document associated with Flock invoice INV-96173 (“Yearly Renewal,” $36,000, approved on the June 23, 2026 consent agenda).
2. The executed agreement currently in effect with Axon Enterprise, Inc. associated with invoice INUS452880 (“In-Car and Body Cameras Upgrade,” $68,034.39, approved on the June 23, 2026 consent agenda), described in the police department’s June 2026 monthly report (July 14, 2026 council packet) as a five-year contract covering in-car cameras, body-worn cameras, and associated software (including Draft One, Translate, and transcription). This includes any quote, order form, master services agreement, statement of work, and product or license schedule, together with any attachments or documents incorporated by reference.
3. All sole-source justifications, bid or quotation waivers, competitive-exception memoranda, or similar records associated with any agreement or contract for goods or services with Flock Group, Inc. or Axon Enterprise, Inc., together with the requisition or purchase order for each such agreement, including any explanation submitted under the City’s Purchasing Policy for why quotations or bids were not obtained.

This request seeks complete executed agreements, including signature pages, not unsigned drafts or proposals. Where no fully executed agreement is available, please provide the most recent proposed or draft version(s) and identify it as such. Please provide records in their original electronic format where possible.

These records are sought for discussion at the October 27, 2026 City Council meeting. If not all responsive records are available before that date, please release the records that are available and provide an estimated date for production of the remainder. If any record or portion thereof is withheld for any reason, including non-existence of a record, please identify what was withheld and the specific reason for its withholding.

Please contact me with any question about scope.

Sincerely,

HCvP
